## What's New in Quote 2.1.0

* "Another quote" on the Daily screen, with undo, and a list of the quotes from earlier days
* Tap an author's name for their portrait, a short bio and more of their quotes; tap a tag to search for it
* Share a quote as an image card, or as text
* Saved: search, sorting, status filters for your own quotes, and multi-select to copy, share or remove several quotes at once
* Undo after deleting or unfavoriting now survives switching tabs and rotating the screen
* Save text from other apps: share it to Quote, or pick "Save to Quote" when you select text
* App shortcuts for Favorites and New quote
* Notifications when a moderator approves or rejects your quote; pending quotes show when you sent them and can be checked on demand
* Choose whether your own quote is English or German when you add or submit it
* Daily reminders have Save and Share buttons
* The widget switches to the new quote at midnight, opens the Daily screen when tapped and works with TalkBack
* Settings show your widgets and when community quotes last synced
* Changing a setting no longer swaps out today's quote
* Tapping the reminder or the widget no longer restarts a running app and loses what you were typing
* Edits survive rotating the screen, and Quote asks before throwing away unsaved changes
* Dark themes follow your accent color everywhere, without the amber buttons and chips
* Better TalkBack support on cards, buttons and the widget
* The privacy policy is now also available in German
* Downloaded updates are checked against the published SHA-256 checksum
* Many smaller fixes to search, German texts and dates, backups and community sync
